interpretation.flat_absorber: NOT invisible: leverage is negative, so a grey absorber makes a star look OVER-luminous in G at fixed M_Ks
interpretation.true_blind_spot: alpha ~ ln(s)/ln(lambda_Ks/lambda_G); an absorber already moderately selective
interpretation.dust: interstellar dust has alpha ~ 2, far on the positive side, so under-corrected reddening mimics the signal directly
